data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word megas, meaning great or mighty. The name Meg carries the meaning “Mighty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Meg usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meg total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Meg, derived from the Greek word megas, has been popularized in various cultures and contexts. In ancient Greece, Megas was a title used for great individuals or deities, indicating their superior strength, power, or influence. In the Middle Ages, Meg meant great or mighty in Old English, a name often given to strong, courageous, or influential women.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Meg holds deep meaning and significance. In the Bible, God is referred to as the mighty one, El Megiddo (the God of the battle). The name Meg can serve as a reminder of God's immense power and majesty, inspiring awe and reverence.
